lines: rāgaṁ ca doṣaṁ ca prahāya mohaṁ
yaṁ kiñci yaṣṭaṁ va hutaṁ va loke
sabbaṁ pi taṁ na catubbhāgam eti
yaṁ ve hitaṁ ca sādhuñ ca
ya keja yaṭha va hoda va loke
sava bi ta na cadubhaku vedi
ya du hida ji sadhu ji
na i aha na i bheṣida
rāgaṁ ca doṣaṁ ca tathaiva mohaṁ
yat kiṁ cid iṣṭaṁ ca hutaṁ ca loke
sarvaṁ pi taṁ na caturbhāgam eti

lines: yad vai hitaṁ ca pathyaṁ ca

primary_corrections.issue: The comparative chapter 12 identifies Patna 317, but its verse text repeats Patna 312, the counterpart of Pāli 157. Cone's native chapter 17 separately prints the genuine Patna 317 and identifies it with Pāli 158.
primary_corrections.line_break_method: Split the native edition's two half-verse paragraphs at their printed em-space pāda boundaries; omit metre scans and the modern prosodic tooltip.
primary_corrections.display_note: The comparative page accidentally repeats the preceding verse under Patna 317. This reading follows the separately checked Cone/Ānandajoti native Patna chapter 17, verse 317; the original duplicate and correction are retained in the source record.
